authored-order.rule: Every expected gating identity resolves exactly once in natural retail relative order. Compiler-generated lifecycle and helper roles remain inventoried for full order but do not gate authored order or authored-byte traversal.

raw-object-extras.raw_population_rule: Inventory every unlisted raw definition. An unlisted raw definition is mechanically non-blocking because OPT:REF and OPT:ICF may discard or fold it after object emission.
blocking_surfaces: phase-appropriate expected gating identity missing duplicated reordered or unexpected
selected linked contribution missing duplicated reordered or unexpected
exact linked RVA or predecessor/successor seam divergence during full order

parallel-arbitration.nonpreemption: Active compatible work is never preempted. A higher-priority newly available packet waits if its normalized claims conflict with an active packet.
parallel-arbitration.fallback_alias: fallback_authored_byte_cursor is a deprecated alias for parallel_authored_byte_cursor and has no accepted-prefix prerequisite.
parallel-arbitration.object_prefix_rule: Authored-object-byte preparation may inspect only the current semantically accepted authored-order prefix and is subordinate evidence preparation, not a peer scheduler.
parallel-arbitration.conflict_rule: Read/read claims coexist. Write/read and write/write overlaps conflict symmetrically after Windows path case-folding and directory-containment normalization.
parallel-arbitration.reservation_rule: Reservations do not expire by time and are released only by returned, closed, or evidence-audited abandonment outcomes.
